# Example

An example glossary in the shape of the repository's own.

## Language

**Brain**:
The body of knowledge kept for one person.
_Avoid_: Vault, second brain, data folder (the folder is where one Machine keeps its copy)

**Replication**:
Keeping every Machine's copy the same.
_Avoid_: Sync, backup

**Source refresh**:
Reading new activity from connected sources.
_Avoid_: Sync, poll

**Harness**:
The agent application the owner talks to.
_Avoid_: Agent, coding agent, auto-save
